about.heroTitle: An international firm dedicated to digital transformation
about.heroSubtitle: From Abidjan, VIT GLOBAL TECHNOLOGIES GROUP supports companies, institutions and investors worldwide in their most ambitious technology projects.
about.storyBody: Founded to bridge the gap between the digital ambitions of African and international organizations and world-class technology excellence, VIT GLOBAL TECHNOLOGIES GROUP quickly grew into a recognized multi-subsidiary group, active in more than 14 countries.
about.visionBody: To become the go-to technology partner for African and international organizations, recognized for its excellence, integrity and ability to turn ambitions into measurable results.
about.missionBody: To design, build and secure technology solutions that sustainably accelerate our clients' growth, while training talent and creating value for all our stakeholders.
about.valuesSubtitle: The principles that guide every one of our decisions and relationships.
about.teamCtaBody: Passionate experts, leading each of the group's areas of expertise.
